messages:
Lina: Heads-up — SatoriFin just filed a serious escalation. After yesterday's canary we pushed for the token-optimizer, they're seeing more confident, extraneous details in summaries (nonexistent partners, wrong contract dates). Customer included a sample response.
Alex: Thanks Lina. Which model + variant did they hit? Any model pins on their tenant?
Lina: They were on rwinf-2.8-fastpath (canary variant). No tenant pin. Customer pasted the request: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rwinf-2.8-fastpath","input":"Summarize Q4 contract with partner AcmeSys","max_tokens":200}'
```
And the response included: "Partner AcmeSys agreed to a revenue share starting 2022-05-01" — which never existed in their records.
Maya: Noted. Any change to sampling (temp/top_p) or system prompt overrides? Also did we flip any grounding/prompt-sanitizer flags?
Lina: Customer says no prompt changes from their side. They just started seeing the pattern after the optimizer rollout at ~08:12 UTC.
deploy-bot: Deployed token-optimizer v1.3 to canary (10%) at 2026-03-16T08:12:04Z
Samir: I rolled the runtime diff earlier — token-optimizer v1.3 does more aggressive prefix trimming and KV reuse heuristics to boost throughput. Potentially trimming too much of the context or changing cached prefix alignment could cause the model to overgeneralize.
Priya: On infra side, no 5xx or auth errors. Latency dropped ~8% for canary. No memory pressure. Logs from the canary region attached (excerpt):
```
[canary-us-west] 08:12:05 request id=abc123 variant=token-optimizer-v1.3 model=rwinf-2.8-fastpath duration=82ms
[canary-us-west] 08:12:06 cache-miss prefix-length=128 trimmed=32
```
Maya: That cache-trim line is interesting. Can we repro locally by toggling enable_prefix_trimming=true/false and running the customer's prompt repeatedly? Ask customer for a small batch of failing prompts to build an eval.
Alex: Lina pls ask for 5 failing examples + the exact HTTP payloads (headers, model, options). Also propose temporary mitigation: pause token-optimizer for their tenant or route them to stable variant rwinf-2.8-standard.
Samir: I can flip routing for that tenant to stable in a minute if CS approves. It requires a config override: `routing.overrides.satoriFin -> rwinf-2.8-standard`. No restart.
Lina: Sending request to SatoriFin now with two options: 1) we pause the optimizer for them and route to standard, 2) we collect 5 failing prompts for immediate repro/eval. Will update.
Maya: If we can repro, I'll run a quick A/B: v1.2 (old optimizer) vs v1.3 on the same prompts and diff logits to see where assertive token probs increased. Could point to a quantization-ish or cache-alignment issue.
Priya: I'll keep an eye on canary metrics while you test. If we see content regression spike across other tenants, we escalate to rollback.
Lina: Customer agreed to the temporary reroute. Samir pls proceed. I'll collect examples and post them here once I have them. Thanks all :pray:
Alex: Thanks team — keep updates in this thread.
